    server Package

    Local development server and JSON API

    Serves the built site and a JSON API for rendering individual pages over HTTP.

    Commands

    pagify preview

    Builds and serves the site on localhost, rebuilding on every request.

    pagify preview ./docs --port 8080

    pagify serve

    Runs the JSON API server. It renders individual pages over HTTP and exposes /api/v1/health, /api/v1/build, /api/v1/openapi.json and /api/v1/docs. All file access is confined to --root.

    pagify serve

    Endpoints

    Method Path Description
    GET /api/v1/health Service health check
    POST /api/v1/build Render one page in memory
    GET /api/v1/openapi.json OpenAPI specification
    GET /api/v1/docs Swagger UI

    Security

    Every content path a request names is resolved through internal/workspace, so the API cannot read outside its --root.
